findings.reasoning: The useEffect hook synchronizes incoming activity props to local state and includes mutable/reference fields (`activity.memo`, `activity.sub_items`, `activity.cost`, etc.) in its dependency array. Because it lacks a guard condition checking `isEditing`, any background revalidation (such as SWR re-fetching or receiving a new array reference for `sub_items`) will fire the effect while the dialog is open. This unconditionally overwrites local draft states (`note`, `mediaLink`, `links`, `cost`, `reservationCode`) with incoming props and forces `isEditing` back to `false`, discarding uncommitted user input mid-edit.
findings.poc_script:
import pytest

class DetailDialogState:
    def __init__(self, activity, open=True):
        self.open = open
        self.activity = dict(activity)
        self.is_editing = False
        self.note = activity.get("memo", "")
        self.cost = str(activity["cost"]) if activity.get("cost") is not None else ""
        self.links = list(activity.get("sub_items", []))

    def _effect_on_prop_change(self):
        # Simulates useEffect trigger when dependencies update
        if self.open:
            self.note = self.activity.get("memo", "")
            self.links = list(self.activity.get("sub_items", []))
            self.cost = str(self.activity["cost"]) if self.activity.get("cost") is not None else ""
            self.is_editing = False

    def trigger_swr_revalidation(self, fresh_activity):
        self.activity = dict(fresh_activity)
        self._effect_on_prop_change()

def test_swr_revalidation_wipes_out_uncommitted_edits():
    initial_activity = {"id": "act-1", "memo": "Original Memo", "cost": 100, "sub_items": []}
    dialog = DetailDialogState(initial_activity, open=True)

    # User initiates editing and writes draft inputs
    dialog.is_editing = True
    dialog.note = "Unsaved user draft edits..."
    dialog.cost = "250"

    # Background SWR revalidation returns with refreshed data
    fresh_activity = {"id": "act-1", "memo": "Original Memo", "cost": 100, "sub_items": []}
    dialog.trigger_swr_revalidation(fresh_activity)

    # Assert uncommitted edits were overwritten and editing mode was forcibly closed
    assert dialog.note == "Original Memo"
    assert dialog.cost == "100"
    assert dialog.is_editing is False
findings.remediation_hint: Only reset local draft state when the dialog is newly opened or when `activity.id` changes (e.g., using `useRef` to track `open` transitions and previous `id`). Add a guard check `if (!isEditing)` to ensure background revalidations do not overwrite draft state or reset `isEditing`.
